card.explain.closed_eyes.ctx: Explanation of ClosedEyes. {count} = number of faces

card.explain.rule.t: The photo matches the rule “{name}”. Rules only suggest.
card.explain.rule.ctx: Explanation of Rule. {name} = the user's name for the rule

card.explain.protected_person.t: The photo shows a person you have protected. It is only moved when you confirm.

people.description.t: The people Fjell has found in your photos. Everything happens on this device.

people.off.title.ctx: Tittel på tom tilstand når ansiktsindeksen er av (standard)

people.off.body.t: If you turn it on, Fjell groups photos that show the same face, so you can name people and protect them. The analysis happens only on this PC. Nothing is sent anywhere, and your original photos are never changed. You can turn the index off and delete it at any time.
people.off.body.ctx: Forklaring i tom tilstand: hva som skjer, on-device, originaler urørt

people.on.empty.title.ctx: Tom tilstand når indeksen er på men listen er tom

people.on.empty.body.t: People appear after the next scan of your photos.
people.on.empty.body.ctx: Forklaring i tom tilstand når indeksen er på

people.unnamed.ctx: Visningsnavn for en person brukeren ikke har navngitt

people.person.pick.ctx: Valg i sammenslåingsdialog. {name} = navn eller «Uten navn», {photos} = antall bilder (ferdig formatert)

people.name.button.ctx: Knapp på en person uten navn som åpner navnefeltet

people.name.change.ctx: Knapp på en person med navn som åpner navnefeltet

people.name.add.aria.ctx: Tilgjengelig navn på Gi navn-knappen. {person} = navn eller «Uten navn» med antall bilder

people.name.change.aria.ctx: Tilgjengelig navn på Endre navn-knappen. {person} = personens navn

people.name.help.t: The name is stored only on this device. Leave the field empty to remove the name.

people.name.changed.ctx: Melding i Toast etter navneendring, med Angre. {person} = personens visningsnavn

people.merge.aria.ctx: Tilgjengelig navn på Slå sammen-knappen. {person} = visningsnavn

people.merge.body.t: Choose the person {person} should be merged with. The photos are gathered under one person. No photos are deleted or changed, and you can undo it.

people.merge.keep.ctx: Gruppeoverskrift: velg personen som beholdes etter sammenslåingen

people.merge.summary.t: {absorbed} is merged into {target}. You can undo it right afterwards.
people.merge.summary.ctx: Oppsummering i sammenslåingsdialogen. {absorbed} = personen som slås inn, {target} = personen som blir stående

people.merge.none.t: There is nobody else to merge with.
people.merge.none.ctx: Vises i sammenslåingsdialogen når det bare finnes én person

people.merge.done.ctx: Melding i Toast etter sammenslåing, med Angre

people.protect.label.ctx: Tekst på beskyttelsesbryteren for en person. {person} = visningsnavn

people.protect.on.done.t: {person} is protected. Photos of this person are never moved without your confirmation.
people.protect.on.done.ctx: Melding i Toast når en person beskyttes, med Angre

people.protect.off.done.ctx: Melding i Toast når beskyttelsen fjernes, med Angre

people.index.on.done.t: The face index is turned on.
people.index.on.done.ctx: Skjermlesermelding etter at indeksen er slått på

people.consent.lead.t: Fjell can group photos by who is in them. It is optional, and people and face recognition stay off until you turn them on.

people.consent.stores.body.t: For each face, Fjell stores a set of numbers (a mathematical fingerprint), which photo it came from and any names you give. No face images are stored.

people.consent.local.body.t: All analysis happens on this PC. Nothing is sent to a server, and nothing is uploaded.

people.consent.originals.body.t: Your photo files are not touched. Fjell only suggests, you decide, and everything can be undone.

people.consent.off.body.t: In Settings you can turn the index off or delete all face data at any time.

settings.faces.description.t: Optional. People and face recognition stay off until you turn them on, and everything happens on this device.

settings.faces.on.note.t: Turned on. Faces are analyzed only on this device, and your original photos are never changed.
settings.faces.on.note.ctx: Forklaring under bryteren når ansiktsindeksen er på

settings.faces.wipe.title.ctx: Tittel på bekreftelsesdialogen for sletting av ansiktsindeksen

settings.faces.wipe.desc.t: Removes all face data and people from this device. Your photos are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.faces.wipe.desc.ctx: Beskrivelse ved Slett ansiktsindeksen-raden i Innstillinger

settings.faces.wipe.irreversible.ctx: Varsel i slettedialogen. Ærlig om at wipe ikke kan angres

settings.faces.wipe.loses.t: Names you have given to people and the protection of people are lost.

settings.faces.wipe.done.t: {count, plural, one {# face was deleted from the index.} other {# faces were deleted from the index.}} Your photos are kept.

rules.note.never.t: A rule never moves, deletes or accepts anything by itself. It only adds its matches as suggestions in Review, and you decide each one.
rules.note.never.ctx: Banner øverst i Regler: regler foreslår bare

rules.sentence.t: Suggests photos where all of these are true: {conditions}.
rules.sentence.ctx: Regelen som lesbar setning. {conditions} = vilkårene skilt med semikolon

rules.hits.label.ctx: Antall bilder en regel treffer akkurat nå. {count} = antall

rules.enabled.named.ctx: Navn på av/på-bryteren for en regel. {name} = brukerens regelnavn

rules.edit.button.ctx: Knapp som åpner en regel for redigering

rules.editor.new.title.ctx: Tittel på regelbyggeren når en ny regel lages

rules.editor.edit.title.ctx: Tittel på regelbyggeren når en regel redigeres

rules.cond.all.t: All conditions must be true for a photo to be suggested.

rules.cond.add.ctx: Knapp som legger til et vilkår

rules.cond.remove.ctx: Knapp som fjerner ett vilkår fra regelen. Bildene røres ikke

rules.cond.kind.label.ctx: Etikett på valget av vilkårstype. {n} = nummer

rules.kind.older_than_days.t: Older than a number of days

rules.value.unit.ctx: Etikett på valg av størrelsesenhet (KB, MB, GB)

rules.preview.button.ctx: Knapp som teller treff uten å lagre noe

rules.preview.stale.t: The conditions have changed. Preview again before you save.

rules.preview.zero.t: No photos match right now. You can still save the rule.

rules.preview.note.t: The preview only counts. It does not save, move or delete anything.

rules.save.needpreview.t: Preview the matches before you save.
rules.save.needpreview.ctx: Forklaring på hvorfor Lagre ikke er klar ennå

rules.saved.t: The rule “{name}” is saved. Its matches show up as suggestions in Review.

rules.toggled.on.ctx: Melding etter at en regel er slått på. {name} = regelnavn

rules.toggled.off.ctx: Melding etter at en regel er slått av. {name} = regelnavn

rules.deleted.t: The rule “{name}” is deleted. Your photos are untouched.
rules.deleted.ctx: Melding i angre-boksen etter sletting av en regel. {name} = regelnavn

rules.restored.ctx: Melding etter Angre på sletting av regel. {name} = regelnavn

rules.error.generic.t: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed.

settings.sensitivity.note.t: The app only suggests. You always decide. The choice applies to new suggestions, not to anything you have already decided.

settings.sensitivity.none.t: Exact copies, screenshots and rule suggestions have no sensitivity to adjust.

settings.sensitivity.help.visual_dup.t: How alike two photos must be to be suggested as similar.
settings.sensitivity.help.visual_dup.ctx: Forklaring under sensitivitetsvalg for like bilder

settings.sensitivity.help.blurry.t: How blurry a photo must be to be suggested.
settings.sensitivity.help.blurry.ctx: Forklaring under sensitivitetsvalg for uskarpe bilder

settings.sensitivity.help.series.t: How close in time photos must be to form a series, and how sure the app must be about closed eyes.

settings.sensitivity.th.gap.t: Most time between photos in a series: {value} s

settings.protections.note.t: Protected photos, folders, albums and people are never moved to the trash unless you confirm each time. Your photos are never changed.

settings.protections.add.ctx: Knapp som åpner dialogen for mappebeskyttelse

settings.protections.folder.note.t: Photos in the folder and its subfolders are never moved to the trash without your confirmation. The folder is not changed.

settings.protections.folder.error.t: Could not protect the folder. Check the path.

settings.protections.confirm.body.t: {target} will no longer be protected. Your photos are not touched, and you can undo right after.

settings.protections.restored.t: The protection for {target} is back on.

settings.protections.since.ctx: Dato en beskyttelse ble satt. {date} = dato

settings.protections.error.t: Could not change the protection. Nothing was changed.

protect.target.id.ctx: Beskrivelse av beskyttet bilde, album eller person uten navn. {id} = nummer

diag.description.t: See what a diagnostics report contains before you save it. The report has only numbers and codes.

diag.preview.label.t: This is what the report looks like

diag.export.button.t: Save report in the diagnostics folder
diag.export.button.ctx: Knapp som lagrer diagnoserapporten i appens egen mappe. Ingenting sendes

diag.export.done.t: The report is saved in Fjell's diagnostics folder. Fjell has not sent it anywhere.
diag.export.done.ctx: Bekreftelse etter at rapporten er lagret

diag.wip.t: This part is a work in progress.
diag.wip.ctx: Plassholder til den ekte diagnosen er på plass

diag.included.body.t: Fjell and Windows versions, screen scaling, the number of photos, suggestions and rules, the index schema version, performance counters and the latest error codes.

diag.excluded.title.ctx: Merkelapp foran det rapporten ikke inneholder

diag.excluded.body.t: photos, paths, file names, folder names, album names, people's names, rule names and face data.

diag.folders.off.t: Folder names are not included. Fjell never includes them without your consent, and never full paths.
diag.folders.off.ctx: Forklaring om at mappenavn er av som standard

diag.preview.hint.t: This is exactly the text that is saved. Nothing else is included.

diag.saved.path.ctx: Foran stien til den lagrede diagnosefilen

diag.saved.hint.t: Send it yourself if you want help. Fjell sends nothing and does not open email.
diag.saved.hint.ctx: Hjelpetekst etter at rapporten er lagret

privacy.local.t: Everything stays on this PC. Fjell sends nothing anywhere.

privacy.diag.note.t: The report has no photos, paths or file names, and you decide what to do with it.

backup.description.t: Fjell can make a copy of its own index. Your photos are not copied and not changed.

backup.create.ctx: Knapp som tar en kopi av indeksen

backup.created.ctx: Bekreftelse etter at en kopi er tatt

backup.entry.ctx: Én kopi i listen. {kind} = type, {date} = dato, {count} = antall bilder

backup.kind.pre_restore.ctx: Type kopi: tatt rett før en gjenoppretting

backup.integrity.check.ctx: Knapp som sjekker at indeksen er hel

backup.restore.body.t: The index is replaced by the backup. Fjell first makes a copy of the current index, so you can undo. Your photos are not changed.

backup.restore.check.t: I understand the index is replaced
backup.restore.check.ctx: Avkrysning som må være på før Gjenopprett virker

backup.recovery.title.ctx: Skjermtittel når indeksen ikke er hel

backup.recovery.description.t: Fjell found a problem with its index and has stopped scanning and changes. Your photos are not affected.

backup.recovery.recheck.ctx: Knapp i trygg modus som sjekker indeksen på nytt

backup.recovery.banner.t: The index is not intact. Fjell is in safe mode.

indexing.state.paused_on_battery.t: Paused because the PC is on battery.

indexing.progress.ctx: Fremdrift i indeksering. {done} og {total} = antall bilder

indexing.eta.t: About {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left

indexing.pause.ctx: Knapp som setter indeksering på pause

indexing.cancel.ctx: Knapp som avbryter indeksering. Det som er funnet beholdes

indexing.state.disk_offline.t: Waiting for the drive to be connected again.
indexing.state.disk_offline.ctx: Indekseringstilstand: mappen eller disken er ikke tilgjengelig

indexing.hint.disk_offline.t: No photos have been deleted. Fjell will try again on its own.
indexing.hint.disk_offline.ctx: Beskjed når disken er frakoblet. Frakoblet disk er aldri det samme som slettede bilder

indexing.hint.battery.t: Continues on its own when the PC is plugged in, or press Resume.
indexing.hint.battery.ctx: Beskjed når indekseringen står på pause fordi PC-en går på batteri

indexing.note.live.t: Suggestions update as it goes. You can review what has been found already.
indexing.note.live.ctx: Rolig beskjed under indeksering: gjennomgang er ikke blokkert

indexing.remaining.ctx: Antall bilder som gjenstår i indeksering. {remaining} = tall

indexing.live.done.ctx: Kunngjøres for skjermleser når indekseringen er ferdig

indexing.settings.hint.t: Automatic keeps the PC usable while Fjell works. More threads are faster but make the PC slower to use.

indexing.settings.description.t: Choose how much of the PC Fjell uses while indexing.

indexing.priority.low.ctx: Prioritet: tar minst mulig fra annet arbeid

indexing.battery.on.ctx: Pause på batteri er slått på

indexing.battery.off.ctx: Pause på batteri er slått av

error.backup_ack_required.t: You need to confirm before the index can be restored.

error.backup_corrupt.t: The backup is damaged and cannot be used.

error.backup_failed.t: The backup could not be made or restored.

error.index_busy.t: Wait for the scan to finish, or cancel it.

backup.restore.for.ctx: Tilgjengelig navn på Gjenopprett-knappen i listen, slik at knappene kan skilles. {kind} = type, {date} = dato

backup.privacy.t: The backup contains only Fjell's index, never your pictures. The index can contain folder paths and people's names. Backups stay on this PC and never leave it.
backup.privacy.ctx: Privacy note under the backup section

backup.newpc.t: If you move to a new PC, the backup remembers folders by their current path. If the folders exist at the same path, everything works as before. Otherwise pick the folders again and Fjell scans them again.
backup.newpc.ctx: Note about moving a backup to a new PC

backup.restored.noundo.t: The previous index could not be opened. It was set aside in the app's data folder and not deleted.
backup.restored.noundo.ctx: Shown after a restore in safe mode when there is no copy to undo to

backup.rebuild.title.ctx: Overskrift for valget i trygg modus

backup.rebuild.body.t: If no copy fits, Fjell can build a new index from your folders. The damaged index is set aside in the app's data folder and is not deleted. "Recently deleted" and undo history are reset, but files that were in quarantine are put back, and no pictures are deleted. Fjell then scans your folders again.
backup.rebuild.body.ctx: Forklaring av hva som skjer når indeksen bygges på nytt

backup.rebuild.check.t: I understand that "Recently deleted" and undo history are reset
backup.rebuild.check.ctx: Avkrysning som må være på før Bygg på nytt virker

backup.rebuild.button.ctx: Knapp som bygger indeksen på nytt
